messages:
maria: Quick ask for hw partners — for our Q3 cost-modeling run we need structured inputs from each supplier: reserved SKU pricing, spot behavior, commit tenors, and any marketplace/listing fees. Can partners share a CSV by EOD next Tue?

jeff: FYI I'll coordinate with Zenith and VoltCloud. Do you have an exact column spec so we avoid back-and-forth?

maria: Yes — trying to keep this machine-readable. Minimum useful columns: `sku`, `region`, `commit_tier` (e.g., 1yr, 3yr), `commit_months`, `reserved_price_usd_monthly`, `spot_price_usd_hourly`, `avg_preempt_rate_30d`, `preempt_rate_stddev`, `median_time_to_preempt_minutes`, `maintenance_windows` (comma-separated local times), `lead_time_days` (for increases), `early_termination_penalty_pct`, `marketplace_fee_pct`, `guaranteed_capacity_pct` (percent of committed pool available during peak).

maria: For modeling we also need distributional info if possible: percent of preempts in first 10m/30m/1h, and eviction correlation with AZ-level maintenance. If you can't provide raw logs, percentiles are fine.

ana: small ask — can you add `sku_quantization_profile` and `compatible_model_types`? some SKUs only support certain int8/int4 paths and that affects unit-cost.

maria: Good call, ana. Add `sku_quantization_profile` and `compat_models` (comma list of typical model families).

tom: On the pricing side: we need confirmed minimum commitment (months), any early-exit fees, and explicit wording on whether reserved price is refundable / transferable. Put legal notes in a separate sheet named `terms`.

jeff: Partners will ask about confidentiality — do we accept aggregated numbers only?

maria: Aggregated numbers are fine for public partners, but for our internal optimizer we may request anonymized logs under NDA. For onboarding, start with aggregated CSV then we'll request a call for deeper telemetry if needed.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: vendor listing fee tiers and revenue share details are at https://marketplace.example.com/fees — please include `marketplace_fee_pct` to reconcile gross vs net.

ana: also request: `typical_burst_capacity_pct` (how much they allow above reserved for short bursts) and `grace_eviction_policy` (boolean/short note) — affects how we model SLOs.

maria: Great — consolidated CSV header example (please use exactly these column names):
```
sku,region,commit_tier,commit_months,reserved_price_usd_monthly,spot_price_usd_hourly,avg_preempt_rate_30d,preempt_rate_stddev,median_time_to_preempt_minutes,percent_preempt_under_10m,percent_preempt_under_30m,percent_preempt_under_60m,maintenance_windows,lead_time_days,early_termination_penalty_pct,marketplace_fee_pct,guaranteed_capacity_pct,sku_quantization_profile,compat_models,typical_burst_capacity_pct,grace_eviction_policy,notes
```

maria: Please drop CSVs to this thread or to the shared drive link (I'll DM the link). Target deadline: next Tue EOD (1732560000) so finance can run scenarios Thursday.

jeff: On it — I'll ping Zenith/VoltCloud/CoreWeave and ask for preliminary numbers by Fri.

an a: if anyone from modelling wants a short sync after we collect CSVs, +1 to schedule 30m.

maria: Thanks — scheduling once we have >50% of partners. :thumbsup:
